name: Mohammad Khalid Jawed
title: Associate Professor
fitReason: ObstaDiff (September2026 primary preprint) separates target, obstacles and background in a structured encoder, using diffusion-policy imitation for clutter-aware approach motions. This provides a direct embodied-AI/manipulation project alongside the lab’s physics-based soft-robot work.

physicalEvidence.summary: ObstaDiff explicitly uses a physical7DoF Sawyer with eye-in-hand RealSenseD455. It evaluates61 distinct indoor-greenhouse configurations per method,366 executions total. The learned component approaches the pepper; final interaction is a replayed demonstration ending in touching the target, not demonstrated harvesting.

shortVisit.summary: The current team page shows a visiting graduate student and visiting researcher, but no general invitation or external eight-week master’s route was verified. Hosting precedent alone receives no opportunity points.
